children.text: 突然不知道遇到什么问题，无法将代码推送到 Github 了

content.code:
# git push -u origin master

Delta compression using up to 8 threads
Compressing objects: 100% (222/222), done.
client_loop: send disconnect: Broken pipe | 86.00 KiB/s
send-pack: unexpected disconnect while reading sideband packet

children.text: 网上搜了一番，说是要增加超时时间，在

content.code:
Host github.com
  HostName ssh.github.com
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_rsa_github
  Port 443
  # ProxyCommand connect -H 127.0.0.1:7890 %h %p
  # 新增下面
  ServerAliveInterval 300
  ServerAliveCountMax 2
  TCPKeepAlive yes

children.text: 然后就可以了，不过这里我把我的代理也去掉了，不知道哪个生效了😂。
